Strategy & Business, 13 November 2024
What trends are shaping the current cyber risk landscape?
Trend Talk with Edward Ler, Chief Underwriting Officer of ERGO Group AG
Compared to traditional property insurance, cyber insurance is still a relatively new form of insurance. Advances in digitalisation mean that it is becoming more and more important. After all, cyber risk exposures have become one of the biggest global risks for business and society in recent years. Hardly a day goes by without hacker attacks on companies or government institutions. There are many reasons behind this development. In his Trend Talk Edward Ler, Chief Underwriting Officer of ERGO Group AG, explores what trends and developments are shaping the current cyber risk landscape.
